title: His Climbing Partner Cut the Rope… But He Survived — Joe Simpson.
note: Written from well-established facts (Simpson's book Touching the Void); web search wasn't permitted in this unattended run, so please check before recording. Kept conservative: 'over twenty thousand feet' (Siula Grande is about 6,344 m / 20,814 ft), 'about an hour', 'about three days', 'over five miles' (accounts give 5 to 6 miles). The title is accurate. 'Still friends' reflects Simpson publicly defending Yates; their friendship later cooled in some accounts, so cut that line if unsure.
